response.sql: WITH team_avg AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(w) AS avg_wins, AVG((g - l) * 1.0 / l) AS avg_ratio FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_wins FROM team_avg) SELECT t.team_id, t.avg_wins, t.avg_ratio, t.avg_wins - o.mean_wins AS gap FROM team_avg t CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE t.avg_wins > o.mean_wins ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 10
